---
title: "worked_example"
---
```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

bird_breeding_sites <- read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(bird_breeding_sites)
colnames(bird_breeding_sites)
glimpse(bird_breeding_sites)
print(nrow(bird_breeding_sites))
print(ncol(bird_breeding_sites))
print(dim(bird_breeding_sites))
migratory_connectivity <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(head(migratory_connectivity))
glimpse(migratory_connectivity)
colnames(migratory_connectivity)

bird_breeding_selected <- bird_breeding_sites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct()

gt(bird_breeding_selected)
bird_breeding_selected <- bird_breeding_sites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

gt(migratory_connectivity)

migration_connectivity_selected <- migratory_connectivity |>
  select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude, Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude, Stopover_Longitude = pslon, Stopover_Latitude = pslat, Iberian_Longitude = iblon, Iberian_Latitude = iblat, Westmost_Longitude = awestlon, Westmost_Latitude = awestlat)

gt(head(migration_connectivity_selected))

bird_breeding_exc <- bird_breeding_selected |>
  filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(bird_breeding_exc)

bird_migration_exc <- migration_connectivity_selected |>
  filter(Site != "Spain")

gt(head(bird_migration_exc))

bird_breeding_dartmoor <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site == "Dartmoor")

gt(bird_breeding_dartmoor)

bird_breeding_not_dartmoor <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site != "Dartmoor")

gt(bird_breeding_not_dartmoor)

bird_breeding_long_10 <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Breeding_Longitude > 10)

gt(bird_breeding_long_10)
```
```{r}

sum(my_numbers)
my_numbers <- c(2, 4, 6, 8)

my_result <- my_numbers |> 
  sum() |>

  round()

print(my_result)
```

```{r}
input_vec <- c(5, -10, 4, -3)
result <- input_vec |>
  mean() |>
  abs() |>
  round()
print(result)
```

```{r}
bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migration_exc |> group_by(Site)

glimpse(bird_migration_grouped)

lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE))

gt(lat_df)

lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(
    Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lowest_Lat_Stopover = min(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Lat_Stopover = mean(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Highest_Lat_Winter = max(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lowest_Lat_Winter = min(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Lat_Winter = mean(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

gt(lat_df)

bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migration_exc |> group_by(Site)

bird_migration_summary <- bird_migration_grouped |> summarise( Stopover_Longitude = median(Stopover_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Stopover_Latitude = median(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Longitude = median(Iberian_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Latitude = median(Iberian_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_Longitude = median(Westmost_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_Latitude = median(Westmost_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Longitude = median(Winter_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Latitude = median(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
gt(bird_migration_summary)
```
